How to use. Your answer is close to an option but not equal? Look up the number here: 0.707 or 0.637, 1.35 or 1.17, 0.9 or 0.45 … Part 1 lists the pairs from small to large with the one-line way to tell them apart. Part 2 lists the factors (×2, ×√3, ×1.11 …) the wrong options were built with in 2,620 past questions.
